services.value: ERA Lab provides analytical testing for wastewater, drinking water, stormwater, groundwater, and sludge. Services include Toxicity Testing (chronic and acute), Priority Pollutants (40 CFR 423) analysis, Long Term BOD testing, sample kits with chain of custody, sample pick-ups & shipments, courier routes in Alabama and Georgia, online review of results, and drinking water monitoring including DMR submissions and CCR preparations.
